body:
Now: every Sports level makes you 3% faster, with no cap. Level 50 = 2.47x speed (running about 17 m a second). Sports XP comes from running and jumping, unlimited, so the faster you get the faster you level.
Why it matters: pizza order timers, races to the bus and Tree park get trivial; friends at level 5 can't keep up with a friend at 50.
New (changed after the kit run): +3% a level as now up to level 11 (= +30%), then no more. Early levels feel exactly as today. (The first version, +0.6% a level, made the Tree park's Hard path jumps fail: they need today's early speed.)
Saves: nothing changes in saves.

comments.text: Karolis said 'do the rebalance' in the Schedules and economy chat (30 Oct): approved. Built as a code patch (economy-rebalance.patch, build 2026103101) and checked with the quick kit; goes live through a pull request in the next repo chat.
Kit line N37 (Tree park) failed with +0.6% a level: Hard path jumps of 2.2 m need today's early speed. Changed to +3% a level up to level 11 (+30%), then flat.

source: chat 2026-10-30: Schedules and economy red team 2
title: Balance 7: Sports level speed boost capped at +30%
